notes: Left / middle / right and end / tackle / guard are from the OFFENSE's point of view, in every table, including the defense tables.
Small samples are noisy: after 2 weeks, a team has only a few dozen designed runs and a single long run moves the averages. Check the attempt counts next to each figure.
Current-season numbers use only games played before Week 3 (weeks 1–2).

Box counts: FTN charting via nflverse (n_defense_box). nflverse participation data (defenders_in_box, offense_formation) is not published for the current season. Box counts of 0 are treated as not charted.
YBC / YAC: Pro Football Reference via nflverse, per player per game. They include every carry (PFR does not split out designed runs), so team figures use non-QB rushers only.
Excluded from 2026 weeks 1–2: 140 scrambles, 56 kneels, 14 aborted snaps, 1 two-point tries.
filters: QB scrambles removed (qb_scramble = 1): dropbacks that turned into runs, not designed runs.
Aborted snaps removed (aborted_play = 1): no designed run happened.
Plays wiped out by penalty removed (play_type = no_play), plus plays nflverse marks deleted.
Designed QB runs are kept and labeled (rusher's roster position = QB); QB sneaks come from FTN (is_qb_sneak).
Explosive run = 10+ rushing yards. Stuff = 0 or fewer rushing yards. Success = EPA > 0 (nflverse success).
Left / middle / right and end / tackle / guard are nflverse run_location / run_gap, from the OFFENSE's point of view.

qualifiers.teams: All teams with at least 1 game in the window are ranked.
qualifiers.rushers: 6.25 designed runs per team game, non-QB (the NFL rushing-title standard).
qualifiers.buckets_current: 3 designed runs per team game in the bucket.
qualifiers.buckets_prior: 25 designed runs in the bucket over the full prior season.
qualifiers.overlap: Most-used gap = at least 10% of the offense's designed runs; mismatch = EPA percentile gap of at least 0.25.
